components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one ink action per group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{font:inherit;font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:0.9375rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--text);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:8px;padding:0.5rem 0.95rem;min-height:2.5rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out,transform 100ms ease-out;background:var(--text);border-color:var(--text);color:var(--bg);font-weight:500;}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--text) 86%,var(--bg));}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--text);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Quiet outline button; the default for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn{font:inherit;font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:0.9375rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--text);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:8px;padding:0.5rem 0.95rem;min-height:2.5rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out,transform 100ms ease-out;}.ds-btn:hover{border-color:var(--text);}.ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--text);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Bare text action in faded ink; sunken fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet{font:inherit;font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:0.9375rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--text);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:8px;padding:0.5rem 0.95rem;min-height:2.5rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out,transform 100ms ease-out;background:none;border-color:transparent;color:var(--muted);padding-inline:0.5rem;}.ds-btn-quiet:hover{color:var(--text);background:var(--sunken);}.ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--text);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action; danger text and a soft danger border.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger{font:inherit;font-family:var(--font-ui);font-size:0.9375rem;line-height:1.3;color:var(--text);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:8px;padding:0.5rem 0.95rem;min-height:2.5rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out,transform 100ms ease-out;color:var(--danger);border-color:color-mix(in oklab,var(--danger) 40%,transparent);}.ds-btn-danger:hover{border-color:var(--danger);}.ds-btn-danger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--text);outline-offset:2px;}

components.css: .ds-mood{display:flex;gap:0.375rem;}.ds-mood button{width:2.75rem;height:2.75rem;padding:0;font-size:1.375rem;line-height:1;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:999px;background:none;filter:grayscale(1);opacity:0.78;cursor:pointer;transition:filter 200ms ease-out,opacity 200ms ease-out,background-color 200ms ease-out,border-color 200ms ease-out,transform 150ms ease-out;}.ds-mood button:hover{filter:none;opacity:1;}.ds-mood button[aria-pressed="true"]{filter:none;opacity:1;background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--mood) 20%,transparent);border-color:color-mix(in oklab,var(--mood) 60%,transparent);}.ds-mood button:active{transform:scale(0.94);}.ds-mood button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--text);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Mood Calendar Day
components.description: Mood days get a filled dot, entry-without-mood days a ring, today an ink ring.
components.html: 345

narrative.overview:
Diary is a notebook that steps back so the writing leads. The interface is monochrome: warm off-white paper, near-black ink, hairline rules, and a serif writing face for anything the user wrote or reads as a page. There are no brand accents. The accent colour is the text colour, so a primary button is simply a filled block of ink.

Colour is reserved for one thing: mood. Mood is an ordinal 1 to 5 scale, drawn as a cool-to-warm diverging palette through a neutral middle, and it appears only where mood is the data (picker, calendar dots, heatmap, distribution bars, the Wrapped wash and share image). Daily screens stay quiet and dense in the way a page is dense: one centred column, generous line height, rules instead of cards. Wrapped is the single expressive surface, where the period's moods wash the page and serif titles get large.

The system deliberately refuses the category default of an indigo-accented card dashboard: no tinted brand colour, no grid of shadowed stat cards, no UI or animation libraries. Everything is plain CSS on custom properties in `src/styles.css`, with light and dark themes that follow the system unless overridden.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome UI: ink on warm paper, accent equals text colour.
Mood is the only expressive colour; danger is the only functional one.
Literata for writing surfaces and page titles; system sans for interface.
Hairline borders and tonal sunken fills instead of shadows.
One centred 44rem column with a sticky top text nav.
Wrapped is the one loud surface; everything else is calm.

rules.name: The Mood Is The Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue appears only where mood is the data. Every other element is drawn from ink, paper and their mixes; a new screen that needs "a bit of colour" uses ink weight or a sunken fill instead.

rules.name: The Ring, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: A day with an entry but no mood is a 1.5px inset ring in `mood-none`, never a filled swatch, so it cannot be read as mood 3.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Mood is always also carried by its emoji, label or accessible name; colour reinforces, it does not inform alone.

rules.name: The Serif Means Page Rule
rules.body: Literata is for things the user writes or reads as a page (entry, titles, excerpts, letters, stat figures). Controls, labels and navigation stay in the system sans.

rules.name: The One Swap Point Rule
rules.body: The writing face is set only through `--font-text` and its `@font-face` files. Literata was chosen over Newsreader; swapping it touches nothing else.

rules.name: The Hairline Over Shadow Rule
rules.body: Lists, sections, stat rows, banners and cards separate with a 1px hairline or a sunken fill. A resting surface never gets a shadow.

dos: **Do** use ink (`--text`) as the only UI accent: primary fill, active underline, focus outline, checkbox accent.
**Do** read every colour from the custom properties on `:root` so both themes and the Wrapped share image stay correct.
**Do** draw a day with an entry but no mood as a 1.5px `--mood-none` ring.
**Do** keep mood emoji as the mood glyphs; they are data, not icons.
**Do** use Literata through `--font-text` for written and page content, and the system sans for controls.
**Do** separate content with hairlines and sunken fills; reserve `--shadow-pop` for floating layers and paper objects.
**Do** keep one primary (ink) button per group.
**Do** self-host fonts and inline icons as 20px, 1.75-stroke SVG; the app makes no asset requests.
donts: **Don't** introduce a brand or accent hue; colour outside the mood scale is limited to `--danger` for errors, destructive actions and the crisis card.
**Don't** use mood colours for decoration, status or emphasis outside mood marks.
**Don't** add UI or animation libraries, icon fonts or remote fonts.
**Don't** build dashboards of shadowed cards; summaries are hairline ledgers.
**Don't** add icons to the nav; it is a sticky top text nav.
**Don't** bring Wrapped's washes, large titles or motion into the daily screens.
